items.text: Missouri local election officials filed suit over gerrymandered congressional districts, challenging the new map before November.
Montana's Democratic Senate candidate Bankhead continued a bipartisan strategy in one of the most closely watched 2026 races.
Iowa Libertarians announced they will appeal a court ruling that denied their candidates ballot access for 2026.
South Dakota's Republican gubernatorial runoff moved to the absentee voting phase, with ballots now available for the state's first-ever runoff election.
Delaware lawmakers defeated a bill that would have established same-day voter registration, leaving the state's deadline at 24 days before Election Day.
